scripts.build: npm run build:io && npm run build:pages && npm run build:games
scripts.build:games: cd corpan/games/hover-runner && npm run build && cd ../../.. && npm run package:games && npm run copy:games
scripts.package:games: npm run package:hover-runner && npm run package:hanzi-atelier
scripts.package:hover-runner: cd corpan/games/hover-runner && zip -r hover-runner.zip manifest.json dist/
scripts.package:hanzi-atelier: cd corpan/games/hanzi-atelier && zip -r hanzi-atelier.zip manifest.json index.js styles.css hanziwriter.min.js HANZIWRITER_LICENSE.txt data/
scripts.copy:games: npm run copy:hover-runner && npm run copy:hanzi-atelier
scripts.copy:hover-runner: mkdir -p web/io/out/corpan/games/hover-runner && cp corpan/games/hover-runner/manifest.json web/io/out/corpan/games/hover-runner/ && cp -R corpan/games/hover-runner/dist web/io/out/corpan/games/hover-runner/ && cp corpan/games/hover-runner/hover-runner.zip web/io/out/corpan/games/
scripts.copy:hanzi-atelier: mkdir -p web/io/out/corpan/games/hanzi-atelier && cp corpan/games/hanzi-atelier/manifest.json web/io/out/corpan/games/hanzi-atelier/ && cp corpan/games/hanzi-atelier/index.js web/io/out/corpan/games/hanzi-atelier/ && cp corpan/games/hanzi-atelier/styles.css web/io/out/corpan/games/hanzi-atelier/ && cp corpan/games/hanzi-atelier/hanziwriter.min.js web/io/out/corpan/games/hanzi-atelier/ && cp corpan/games/hanzi-atelier/HANZIWRITER_LICENSE.txt web/io/out/corpan/games/hanzi-atelier/ && cp -R corpan/games/hanzi-atelier/data web/io/out/corpan/games/hanzi-atelier/ && cp corpan/games/hanzi-atelier/hanzi-atelier.zip web/io/out/corpan/games/
